description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) percentage for different models, including Base, FT, IKE, MEND, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), and ROME (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 29% at a co-occurrence number of 3 and increases to approximately 32% at 10^3. The FT line begins at around 32% and rises to about 39% at 10^3. The IKE line starts at approximately 33% and increases to around 42% at 10^3. The MEND line begins at around 36% and rises to approximately 46.5% at 10^3, with a slight plateau between 10^2 and 10^3. The ROME line starts at around 43.5% and increases to approximately 58% at 10^3, with a steeper incline between 10^1 and 10^2. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as the co-occurrence number increases.
